ME TEST KIT with its accessories:
Two plugs to test connection ( + / - )
Two plugs to SDE auxiliary connect.
Review technical reference material and manufacture's manual.
Make sure that the breaker (400v) is in position (OFF).

Change the switch (dc source for the charger motor of breaker) to position OFF to charge the breaker spring manually when the breaker 
 discharged.
Remove the breaker from its location to position OUT.

Remove the cover of breaker and connect the two plugs for the 
 test connection on breaker to the current injection outlets on the tester ( 
 points no.15- fig. 1 )
Connect the two plugs for tripping contacts on the tester (points17-fig.1) to breaker auxiliary points ( 42 / 41).

Set the duration of the injection on [ 6-thump wheels (point 
 no.11- fig.1) ] on the tester. Where this duration is higher than the tripping 
 time of the breaker (400v).

Set the injected current (mA) on [ 4-thump wheel (point no.10 
 -fig1) ]. We begin with 100 mA.

Press selector push-button (point no.14-fig1) to select earth 
 fault protection [ i.e LED
( point 8 is ON ].

Press the start button on tester then LED ready be ON and record 
 the value displayed on the screen (point 9 fig1) which the time of the 
 relay at the set injected current. Then record the injected current and its 
 time recorded on test sheet.
Press reset push-button.

Repeat from point 7 to point 11 with another value of 
 injected current and record the values.

With many values of injected current and time recorded then 
 draw the curve between current and time.

Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding 
 the work area is required.
Safety 
 and Healthy equipment must be used 
 (safety Helmet, safety shoes, ...etc).
Tools and 
Equipment
ME TEST KIT with its accessories:
Two plugs to test connection ( + / - )
Two plugs to SDE auxiliary connect.
Work to be Carried out
Review technical reference material and manufacture's manual.
Make sure that the breaker (400v) is in position (OFF).
Change the switch (dc source for the charger motor of breaker) to position OFF to charge the breaker spring manually when the breaker 
 discharged.
Remove the breaker from its location to position OUT.
Remove the cover of breaker and connect the two plugs for the 
 test connection on breaker to the current injection outlets on the tester ( 
 points no.15- fig. 1 )
Connect the two plugs for tripping contacts on the tester (points17-fig.1) to breaker auxiliary points ( 42 / 41).
Set the duration of the injection on [ 6-thump wheels (point 
 no.11- fig.1) ] on the tester. Where this duration is higher than the tripping 
 time of the breaker (400v).
Set the injected current (mA) on [ 4-thump wheel (point no.10 
 -fig1) ]. We begin with 100 mA.
Press selector push-button (point no.14-fig1) to select earth 
 fault protection [ i.e LED
( point 8 is ON ].
Press the start button on tester then LED ready be ON and record 
 the value displayed on the screen (point 9 fig1) which the time of the 
 relay at the set injected current. Then record the injected current and its 
 time recorded on test sheet.
Press reset push-button.
Repeat from point 7 to point 11 with another value of 
 injected current and record the values.
With many values of injected current and time recorded then 
 draw the curve between current and time.
Note: Current injection stops on any of the 
following events:
Press the stop / reset button.
Change to state of the contact connected to the SDE 
 terminals of the test kit .
End of set duration.
Tripping of the kits 
 thermal protection system ( ? " LED on ).
Injection circuit open, 
 for example a faulty test plug connection ( ? " LED on ).
Another test may be carried out when the READY LED comes 
 on (end of cooling period).
Reclose the circuit breaker after each test.
